meta.status: PROPOSAL — nothing added to exercises.json (spec §3.2). The library is owned by another session.
meta.derivedFrom: certification curriculum — technique written in Bunyan's own words from js/knowledge (corrective, core, balance, plyometrics, saq); no book text, no book images
meta.checkedAgainst: GitHub main exercises.json (876 entries) on 2026-10-20 — none of these ids or names exists there
meta.fields: the library's own keys (i, m, e, d, p, c, x) plus name, nameAr, category, src, mechanics, cues/cuesAr (≤2, ≤10 words), image, nearest
meta.image: every entry is image:null — NONE has an image yet. Per §3.3: re-check free-exercise-db (CC0), then Wikimedia Commons (CC0/CC-BY, credited in CREDITS.md), else SVG line art drawn from `mechanics`. An entry without an image does not ship.
meta.nearest: where the library has something close, `nearest` names it — owner decides: add as new, add as a variant, or skip
meta.excluded: book drills the library already has (e.g. soleus stretch, 90/90 hamstring, plank, dead bug, Pallof press, bridges) and the five controversial stretches (corrective.js CONTROVERSIAL)
meta.tags: m and x use the library's 13 groups via anatomy.js MUSCLE_MAP. tagFromBook:true = the book names the target muscle (or, for squat and lunge patterns, the pattern's muscles in 21.3); without it the tag is Bunyan's choice by movement pattern — owner review.

exercises.name: Thoracic Spine SMR
exercises.mechanics: Lie back over a foam roller across the upper back, hips lifted, hands behind the head or arms crossed; roll between the shoulder blades to gain thoracic extension. Stay off the low back and neck.
cues: Roll mid-back only; never the low back.
Pause 30 seconds on tender spots.
cuesAr: افرد نص الضهر بس؛ مش أسفل الضهر أبدًا.
اثبت ٣٠ ثانية على الأماكن اللي بتوجع.

exercises.name: Adductor SMR
exercises.mechanics: Face down, roller perpendicular to the inner thigh of a bent-out leg; roll the length of the inner thigh, stopping short of the knee.
cues: Roller across the inner thigh; avoid the knee.
Pause 30 seconds on tender spots.
cuesAr: الرولر بالعرض تحت الفخد من جوه؛ ابعد عن الركبة.
اثبت ٣٠ ثانية على الأماكن اللي بتوجع.

exercises.name: TFL SMR
exercises.mechanics: Lie partly on the side over a roller placed on the front-outer thigh just below the pelvis; small movements only, staying off the hip bone.
cues: Front-outer hip, just below the pelvis; small moves.
Stay off the hip bone.
cuesAr: قدام جنب الحوض تحت العضمة؛ حركات صغيرة.

exercises.name: Static Supine Biceps Femoris Stretch
exercises.mechanics: On the back, one hip bent to 90°, other leg flat; draw the bent leg across the body and straighten the knee until the outer hamstring stretches. Both shoulders stay down.
cues: Leg across the body; shoulders stay down.
Mild stretch, hold 30 seconds.
cuesAr: الرجل على جسمك بالعرض؛ الكتاف على الأرض.

exercises.name: Static Standing Biceps Femoris Stretch
exercises.mechanics: One foot on a low box, that leg turned in and slightly across; hands together, rotate the torso away from the raised leg. The leg need not be above hip height.
cues: Foot on a low box, leg turned in.
Rotate away; hold 30 seconds.
cuesAr: رجلك على صندوق واطي، الرجل لافّة لجوه.

exercises.name: Static Seated Ball Adductor Stretch
exercises.mechanics: Sit on a stability ball in a side-lunge position until the inner thigh of the straight leg stretches; tuck the pelvis and draw the navel in.
cues: Side-lunge on the ball; tuck the pelvis.
Draw in; hold 30 seconds.
cuesAr: طعنة جانبية على الكورة؛ ادخّل الحوض.

exercises.name: Static Adductor Magnus Stretch
exercises.mechanics: Standing, one foot up on a bench or box; reach down toward it only as far as the spine stays long, until the inner-back thigh stretches.
cues: Foot on a bench; reach down, spine long.
Hold 30 seconds.
cuesAr: رجلك على بنش؛ انزل وضهرك مفرود.

exercises.name: Static Standing TFL Stretch
exercises.mechanics: Staggered stance, front knee soft, rear leg straight with the foot turned out; draw in, tuck the pelvis, squeeze the rear-side glute. Progression: reach the same-side arm up and over.
cues: Rear foot out; tuck pelvis, squeeze that glute.
Reach over only if the pelvis stays still.
cuesAr: الرجل اللي ورا لبرّه؛ ادخّل الحوض واقفل المؤخرة.
مد إيدك فوق بس لو الحوض ثابت.

exercises.name: Static Supine Piriformis Stretch
exercises.mechanics: On the back, cross one leg over the other straight leg; with the low back neutral, draw the bent knee toward the opposite shoulder.
cues: Knee toward the opposite shoulder.
Low back neutral; hold 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Static Seated Erector Spinae Stretch
exercises.mechanics: Seated, one leg crossed over the other straight leg; rotate the trunk toward the crossed leg's side.
cues: Rotate toward the crossed leg.
Sit tall; hold 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Static Ball Latissimus Dorsi Stretch
exercises.mechanics: Kneeling on all fours, one arm on a stability ball, thumb up; roll the ball forward until the side of the back stretches. Tuck the pelvis and draw in.
cues: Thumb up; roll forward to the stretch.
Tuck the pelvis; hold 30 seconds.
cuesAr: الصباع لفوق؛ زق الكورة لقدام لحد الشد.

exercises.name: Static Pectoral Stretch
exercises.mechanics: One arm at 90/90 (upper arm level, elbow bent) against a frame; lean forward until the front shoulder and chest stretch, without shrugging.
exercises.nearest: Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch (library)
cues: Arm at 90/90; lean forward gently.
No shrugging; hold 30 seconds.
cuesAr: من غير رفع كتاف؛ اثبت ٣٠ ثانية.

exercises.name: Static Levator Scapulae Stretch
exercises.mechanics: Hand on top of the head, tilt the ear toward the same shoulder, then turn to look into that armpit; chin stays back, shoulders down.
cues: Tilt, then look into the armpit.
Chin back, no shrug; mild tension.
cuesAr: الدقن لورا، من غير رفع كتاف؛ شد خفيف.

exercises.name: Static Sternocleidomastoid Stretch
exercises.mechanics: Hand on top of the head, tilt the ear toward the same shoulder, then rotate the face up and away; to mild tension only.
cues: Tilt, then turn the face up and away.
Mild tension only — hold 30 seconds.
cuesAr: ميّل، وبعدين لف وشك لفوق وبعيد.

exercises.name: Prisoner Squat
exercises.mechanics: Hands behind the head, feet about shoulder width; bodyweight squat. Progression: add a calf raise at the top.
cues: Hands behind head; knees over toes.
Add a calf raise once smooth.
cuesAr: الإيد ورا الراس؛ الركب فوق الصوابع.
ضيف رفعة سمانة لما تبقى سلسة.

exercises.name: Multiplanar Lunge with Reach
exercises.nameAr: طعنة في كل الاتجاهات مع مد
exercises.mechanics: Lunge forward, to the side and turning — all three planes — reaching with the arms.
cues: Forward, side, then turning lunge.
Front knee over the second and third toes.
cuesAr: طعنة لقدام، وبعدين للجنب، وبعدين بلفّة.
الركبة اللي قدام فوق الصباع التاني والتالت.

exercises.name: Lunge with Rotation
exercises.mechanics: Forward lunge, then rotate the trunk toward the front leg's outside. Optional light medicine ball.
cues: Rotate toward the front leg's side.
Turn through the upper back.

exercises.name: Tube Walking: Side to Side
exercises.mechanics: Band around the knees (ankles to progress), quarter squat; side-step, knees tracking over the second and third toes. Targets gluteus medius.
exercises.nearest: Monster Walk (library) — same tool, different direction
cues: Quarter squat; step sideways.
Knees stay out over the toes.

exercises.name: Leg Swings: Front to Back
exercises.mechanics: Standing tall, abdominals drawn in, swing one leg front to back in a controlled pendulum, only as high as it can be controlled.
cues: Controlled swing, only as high as you control.
Stand tall, abs drawn in.
cuesAr: مرجحة متحكم فيها، على قد ما تتحكم.

exercises.name: Leg Swings: Side to Side
exercises.mechanics: Standing tall, abdominals drawn in, swing one leg side to side across the body in a controlled pendulum.
cues: Controlled side-to-side swing.
Stand tall, abs drawn in.
cuesAr: مرجحة متحكم فيها من جنب لجنب.

exercises.name: Frankenstein Walk
exercises.mechanics: Walk forward with arms out in front, kicking each straight leg up only as high as can be controlled; back neutral, no side lean.
exercises.nearest: Frankenstein Squat (library) — a different exercise, same name stem
cues: Kick only as high as you control.
Back neutral; no leaning sideways.
cuesAr: الضهر محايد؛ من غير ميل للجنب.

exercises.name: High Knee Walk
exercises.mechanics: Walking forward, pull each knee up with both hands as high as controlled; pause at the top, switch legs each step.
exercises.nearest: One Knee To Chest (library) — static, not walking
cues: Hug the knee up; pause at the top.
Switch legs each step.

exercises.name: Push-up with Rotation
exercises.mechanics: Bodyweight push-up, then rotate the trunk at the top to reach one arm up; abdominals drawn in, chin tucked, spine neutral.
cues: Push up, then rotate to a side plank.
Chin tucked, spine neutral.

exercises.name: Ball Russian Twist
exercises.mechanics: Shoulders on a stability ball in a bridge, hips up; rotate the trunk side to side while holding the bridge. Optional light medicine ball.
cues: Hold the bridge; hips stay up.
Rotate through the trunk, slowly.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.mechanics: Classic jumping jacks, only enough to raise heart rate and breathing slightly — a warm-up, not a workout.
cues: Easy pace — just warm up.

exercises.name: Marching
exercises.mechanics: On the back, knees bent, abdominals drawn in; lift one foot slightly then the other, keeping the pelvis still. A belly that pushes out means the deep core has switched off.
cues: Draw in; lift one foot at a time.
Belly bulging? Slow down and reset.

exercises.name: Floor Cobra
exercises.mechanics: Face down; lift the chest a little while squeezing the shoulder blades back and down, arms turned out with thumbs up. Do not lift so high the low back over-arches.
cues: Shoulder blades back and down; thumbs up.
Small lift — no low-back arch.
cuesAr: لوحي الكتف لورا ولتحت؛ الصباع لفوق.

exercises.name: Ball Cobra
exercises.mechanics: Face down over a stability ball, feet braced against something sturdy; lift the chest and squeeze the shoulder blades back and down, thumbs up.
cues: Feet braced; squeeze shoulder blades together.
Thumbs up; no low-back arch.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.mechanics: On all fours, abdominals drawn in, head neutral; lift one bent leg out to the side. Strengthens the hip external rotators.
cues: Draw in; lift the knee out sideways.
Hips level; head neutral.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.mechanics: On all fours, reach one arm forward (thumb up) and the opposite leg back, spine neutral throughout, no low-back arch.
cues: Opposite arm and leg; thumb up.
Spine neutral — no low-back arch.
cuesAr: دراع ورجل عكس بعض؛ الصباع لفوق.

exercises.name: Cable Rotation
exercises.mechanics: Side-on to a cable at chest height, arms long; rotate away, pivoting the back leg so hip, knee and ankle extend — this spares the low back.
cues: Pivot the back leg: hip, knee, ankle extend.
Rotate through the upper back.
cuesAr: لف الرجل اللي ورا: الحوض والركبة والكاحل يتفردوا.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance
exercises.mechanics: Stand heel to toe on a stable floor and hold. The step between two-foot narrow stance and single-leg stance in the balance progression.
cues: Heel to toe; stand tall and hold.
Ready? Progress to one leg.
cuesAr: الكعب قدام الصباع؛ اقف مفرود واثبت.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance
exercises.mechanics: Stand on one leg on the floor, stance-leg glutes contracted, hips level, knee over the toes. Progress the surface only after mastering the floor.
cues: Squeeze the standing glute; hips level.
Knee over toes; master the floor first.
cuesAr: اقفل مؤخرة الرجل اللي واقف عليها؛ الحوض مستوي.
الركبة فوق الصوابع؛ اتقن الأرض الأول.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance Reach
exercises.mechanics: On one leg, reach the free leg out (front, side or behind) and return, keeping the hips level.
cues: Reach the free leg; hips stay level.
Standing glute on throughout.
cuesAr: مؤخرة الرجل الواقفة مشدودة طول الوقت.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Rotation
exercises.mechanics: On one leg, rotate the pelvis in and out over the stance hip — the turn comes from the hip, not the spine.
cues: Turn from the standing hip, not the spine.
Knee stays over the toes.
cuesAr: اللفّة من حوض الرجل الواقفة، مش الضهر.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lift and Chop
exercises.mechanics: On one leg, move a light ball or band diagonally high-to-low and low-to-high across the body while the stance knee stays aligned with the toes.
cues: Stance knee stays in line with toes.
Move the arms; keep the hips still.
cuesAr: ركبة الرجل الواقفة على خط الصوابع.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Squat Touchdown
exercises.mechanics: On one leg, squat and reach the opposite hand down — to the knee first, then the shin, then the foot as control improves.
cues: Reach knee, then shin, then foot.
Knee over the second and third toes.
cuesAr: وصّل للركبة، وبعدين الساق، وبعدين القدم.

exercises.name: Multiplanar Lunge to Balance
exercises.mechanics: Lunge forward, sideways or turning, then push back up to stand balanced on the front leg. Keep the stride modest, especially with tight hip flexors.
cues: Modest stride; push up to one-leg balance.
No low-back arch on the lunge.
cuesAr: خطوة معقولة؛ اطلع لتوازن على رجل.

exercises.name: Multiplanar Hop with Stabilization
exercises.nameAr: نطّة في كل الاتجاهات مع ثبات
exercises.mechanics: Hop forward, sideways or turning and land on one leg; hold the landing 3–5 seconds, soft and quiet, knee over the toes.
cues: Land soft and quiet; hold 3–5 seconds.
Knee over the second and third toes.
cuesAr: انزل بنعومة ومن غير صوت؛ اثبت ٣–٥ ثواني.

exercises.name: Squat Jump with Stabilization
exercises.mechanics: Small squat jump, land and hold 3–5 seconds, correcting posture before the next jump; knees in line with the toes, no feet turning out.
cues: Small jump; hold the landing 3–5 seconds.
Fix your posture before the next one.

exercises.name: Box Jump-Down with Stabilization
exercises.mechanics: Step off a box (jumping off is the progression) and land on both feet, soft and quiet, knees bent and over the toes; hold the landing.
cues: Step off first; land soft, knees bent.
Never land straight-legged.
cuesAr: انزل بخطوة الأول؛ انزل بنعومة والركب متنية.

exercises.name: Power Step-Up
exercises.mechanics: One foot on a box, drive up explosively and switch feet in the air, landing with the other foot on the box; knees over the toes on take-off and landing.
cues: Drive up hard; switch feet in the air.
Knees over toes, up and down.
cuesAr: ادفع لفوق بقوة؛ بدّل رجليك في الهوا.

exercises.name: Speed Ladder: One-Ins
exercises.nameAr: سلم السرعة: رجل في كل مربع
exercises.mechanics: Run the length of an agility ladder placing one foot in each square, technique before speed.
cues: One foot per square; light and quick.
Technique first, speed later.
cuesAr: رجل في كل مربع؛ خفيف وسريع.

exercises.name: Stand-Up to Figure 8
exercises.mechanics: From a chair, stand up quickly, walk a figure 8 around two cones set ahead in a line (about 3–4.5 m and 6–7.6 m), return and sit; repeat the other way. Built for older adults' daily movement.
cues: Stand up fast; walk the figure 8.
Sit back down with control.
